PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
Appointment of Committees in terms of Articles 56(1) and 56(2) of the Constitution

01. On the direction of the Public Service Commission, following members are hereby appointed to the Committeefor the Education Service Sector constituting three members for a period of one year in terms of Article56(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka with effect from 1st of MarchTwo Thousand Nineteen (2019).
I. Mr. M. M. N. D. Bandara (Chairman)II. Mr. E. H. M. P. Elkaduwa (Member)III. Mr. K. L. Mohomed Thamby (Member)

02. Accordingly, the contents stated in the Gazette Notification published in the Gazette Extraordinary of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, No. 1989/27 dated 19th October 2016 are amended with effectfrom 1st of March Two Thousand Nineteen (2019).
By Order of the Public Service Commission,
M. A. B. DAYA SENARATH,Secretary,Public Service Commission.Office of the Public Service Commission,No. 1200/9, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,11th April, 2019.

Appointment of Committees in terms of Articles 56(1) and 56(2) of the Constitution

01. On the direction of the Public Service Commission, Mr. S. M. Gotabhaya Jayarathne is hereby appointed tothe Committee for the Health Service Sector constituting three members until further notice in terms ofArticle 56(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka from 21st February TwoThousand Nineteen (2019) in place of the member, Mrs. W.
